raw.description: 自身存活于场下时，若自身所有技能均以“雷”冠名，则对方每次执行概率低于自身体力百分比的异常状态附加效果时，己方获得1点辰律；自身存活于场上时，若自身所有技能均以“雷”冠名，则自身使用攻击技能后有自身体力百分比的概率令对手麻痹，未触发则吸取对手70%的体力，对手免疫百分比伤害则改为汲取对手70%的体力|回合开始时，若对手处于能力提升状态则每有1种当回合自身使用攻击技能后附加70点固定伤害，若对手不处于能力提升状态则当回合自身攻击技能先制+1且对手的伤害减少效果比例不超过30%，若场上存在点亮的雷辰则转化为自身的雷辰并尽可能以“ㄣ”形连接|战斗阶段结束时，若自身体力低于最大体力的1/3，则恢复自身所有体力、消除对手回合类效果和护盾效果、获得4颗点亮的雷辰并尽可能以“ㄣ”形连接，每场战斗限1次（boss无效）

review.rationale: 原始六答、理论回复/减伤顺序补答及新增007=225、008=不获得均落实；真实HP/PP、概率、槽位、消耗、时长、分层减伤与来源边界有专项。真实场下和下一只出场仍延期。
review.singleBehavior: 实际在场双方回合初强化种类、先制与总比例减伤最多30%，先限总上限再按真实穿减；修罗意念按原贡献比例分摊后计入。攻击麻痹失败按敌最大HP70%吸取，免粉改真汲取，两者按理论量回复。危急一次全回复、清敌回合/盾、获得四槽并按北西东南连接；辰律保留占槽参与连接与末位消耗，满四槽不获得，不排队。单回合多点末一次载荷，四槽觉醒与自身既有雷辰转换保留真实来源。
review.deferredBehavior: 自身存活场下时，真实场上对方每次执行低于自身HP百分比的异常附加概率时为己方增加辰律。
review.trigger: 支援者真实存活场下、其全部技能雷冠名且执行异常概率低于其HP百分比
futureMechanisms: 场下存活支援者与配招查询
队伍辰律归属与异常执行事件

dependencyEvidence.quote: 自身存活于场下时，若自身所有技能均以“雷”冠名，则对方每次执行概率低于自身体力百分比的异常状态附加效果时，己方获得1点辰律

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review

success.name: 4946/2146无关回血、禁疗、固定伤害减伤计时不阻塞攻击；分类不匹配不参与减伤
success.assertion: test('4946/2146无关回血、禁疗、固定伤害减伤计时不阻塞攻击；分类不匹配不参与减伤',()=>{const baseline=run().damage;for(const [name,data]of [['每回合回复',{fraction:.1}],['固定伤害减半',{}],['技能禁疗',{}],['分类攻击减伤',{kind:1,fraction:.8}]]){const result=run(s=>timer(s,1,name,data));assert.equal(result.damage,baseline,name);}});

success.name: 4946/2146现有回合比例减伤单来源上限30%，不改写授予量
success.assertion: test('4946/2146现有回合比例减伤单来源上限30%，不改写授予量',()=>{for(const name of ['回合闪避失败减伤','幻境本回合减攻','神驰当回合减攻','减伤高伤随机异常']){const values=[];for(const fraction of [.3,.5,1]){const result=run(s=>timer(s,1,name,{fraction}));values.push(result.damage);}assert.equal(values[0],values[1],name);assert.equal(values[0],values[2],name);}const base=run(s=>timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.3})).damage;for(const name of ['战狂下回合减伤','全伤害减半'])assert.equal(run(s=>timer(s,1,name,{})).damage,base,name);});

success.name: 4946/2146现有低体、次数、下一次完整比例减伤限制30%且正常消费
success.assertion: test('4946/2146现有低体、次数、下一次完整比例减伤限制30%且正常消费',()=>{const baseline=run(s=>timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.3})).damage;for(const setup of [(s,t)=>t.soulState.lowHp=true,(s,t)=>{t.counts.attackReductionUses=1;t.soulState.attackReductionFraction=1;},(s,t)=>t.soulState.nextDamageReductionFraction=1]){const result=run(setup);assert.ok(Math.abs(result.damage-baseline)<=1,JSON.stringify({actual:result.damage,baseline}));assert.equal(result.s.fighters[1].counts.attackReductionUses??0,0);assert.equal(result.s.fighters[1].soulState.nextDamageReductionFraction,undefined);}});

success.name: 4946/2146百分百比例减伤被限为30%，攻击免疫仍归零并消费免疫次数
success.assertion: test('4946/2146百分百比例减伤被限为30%，攻击免疫仍归零并消费免疫次数',()=>{const reduced=run((s,t)=>{t.counts.nextAttackReductionUses=1;t.soulState.nextAttackReductionFraction=1;});assert.ok(reduced.damage>0);assert.equal(reduced.s.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackReductionUses,0);const immune=run((s,t)=>t.counts.attackNullify=1);assert.equal(immune.damage,0);assert.equal(immune.s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify,0);});

success.name: 4946/2146下次攻击减伤50%限制30%且消费一次，半伤计数同样保留实际消费
success.assertion: test('4946/2146下次攻击减伤50%限制30%且消费一次，半伤计数同样保留实际消费',()=>{const damage=[];for(const fraction of[.3,.5]){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackReductionUses=1;s.fighters[1].soulState.nextAttackReductionFraction=fraction;turn(s,38536,20309);damage.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackReductionUses,0);}assert.equal(damage[0],damage[1]);const p=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[1].counts.halfDamage=1;turn(p,38536,20309);assert.equal(sum(p),damage[0]);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].counts.halfDamage,0);});

success.name: 4946/2146对真实4947技能1265授予的下一次50%减伤限制30%，次数仍只消耗一次
success.assertion: test('4946/2146对真实4947技能1265授予的下一次50%减伤限制30%，次数仍只消耗一次',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4947/snapshot.json'),values=[];for(const reference of[true,false]){const s=make({move:29456,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[10006,38536,29455,29456,38538],enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[38539,29457,29458,31349,38541]});turn(s,29456,38539);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackReductionUses,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.nextAttackReductionFraction,.5);if(reference)s.fighters[1].soulState.nextAttackReductionFraction=.3;turn(s,38536,29458);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackReductionUses,0);}assert.equal(values[0],values[1]);});

success.name: 4946/2146雷冠名复用Q-4765-002排除同ID雷祭/雷电击，不能只检查名字首字雷
success.assertion: test('4946/2146雷冠名复用Q-4765-002排除同ID雷祭/雷电击，不能只检查名字首字雷',()=>{for(const ordinary of[20085,10171]){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[ordinary,38536,29455,29456,38538]});turn(s,38536,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);}const p=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[38536,29455,29456,38537,38538]});turn(p,38536,20309);assert.ok(p.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);});

success.name: 4946/2146真实50%体力概率保留麻痹成功失败，失败按敌最大HP七成理论回复，不隔离参数
success.assertion: test('4946/2146真实50%体力概率保留麻痹成功失败，失败按敌最大HP七成理论回复，不隔离参数',()=>{const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,38536,20309);const status=!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'];seen.add(status);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),status?0:6300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,status?4500:9000);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([true,false]));});

success.name: 4946/2146实际用攻整招无效仍执行魂印吸取；免粉改真即使真伤被免仍按理论量回复，不回退百分比
success.assertion: test('4946/2146实际用攻整招无效仍执行魂印吸取；免粉改真即使真伤被免仍按理论量回复，不回退百分比',()=>{const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500});timer(s,0,'skillBlock');s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,38536,20309);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),6300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);const x=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500});timer(x,1,'固定百分比免疫');timer(x,1,'当回合免伤');x.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(x,38536,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain.type,'true');assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain.settledDamage,0);assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),0);assert.equal(sum(x,'true'),0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].hp,9000);});

success.name: 4946/2146对真实2132魂印单一动态减伤50%与80%限制30%，原始状态保持，不改写目标魂印
success.assertion: test('4946/2146对真实2132魂印单一动态减伤50%与80%限制30%，原始状态保持，不改写目标魂印',()=>{const values=[];for(const fraction of[.2,.3,.5,.8]){const s=battle(fraction);turn(s,38536,20045);values.push(sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.renado2132.reductionRound,1);}assert.ok(values[0]>values[1]);assert.equal(values[1],values[2]);assert.equal(values[1],values[3]);});

success.name: 4946/2146真实2132动态减伤与额外减伤共存按总30%，原层授予量不改
success.assertion: test('4946/2146真实2132动态减伤与额外减伤共存按总30%，原层授予量不改',()=>{const s=battle(.5);timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.2});const ref=battle(.3);turn(s,38536,20045);turn(ref,38536,20045);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(ref));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.renado2132.reduction,.5);});

success.name: 4946/2146真实最大HP70%百分比吸取及免粉后真实汲取均恢复理论量，技能禁疗不挡魂印
success.assertion: test('4946/2146真实最大HP70%百分比吸取及免粉后真实汲取均恢复理论量，技能禁疗不挡魂印',()=>{for(const pinkImmune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(pinkImmune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,38536,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain.type,pinkImmune?'true':'percent');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain.requested,6300);assert.equal(sum(s,pinkImmune?'true':'percent'),6300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain.hpLoss,6300);}});

success.name: 4946/2146七成吸取护罩抵挡仍按理论量回复，真实汲取不扣护罩，整罩零伤不减少魂印理论回复
success.assertion: test('4946/2146七成吸取护罩抵挡仍按理论量回复，真实汲取不扣护罩，整罩零伤不减少魂印理论回复',()=>{for(const mode of ['percent','true','whole-barrier']){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='true')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');const barrier=mode==='whole-barrier'?8000:400;S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],barrier,'existing-barrier');turn(s,38536,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,mode==='true'?'true':'percent'),mode==='true'?6300:mode==='percent'?5900:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,mode==='true'?400:mode==='percent'?0:1700);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain.requested,6300);}});

success.name: 4946/2146已答四颗及觉醒流程：真实执行北西东南路径，真实清异常负级、三回觉醒0PP用招与红伤回血
success.assertion: test('4946/2146已答四颗及觉醒流程：真实执行北西东南路径，真实清异常负级、三回觉醒0PP用招与红伤回血',()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp:2999,loadout:[10006,38536,29455,29456,38538]});s.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['失明']=3;turn(s,29455,20117);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966;assert.deepEqual(st.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(st.connections,[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]]);assert.equal(st.awake.sourceHash,'aab36e4c');assert.equal(st.awake.start,2);assert.equal(st.awake.end,4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['失明'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,0);s.fighters[0].hp=4500;s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)]=0;s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');const old=E.SOULS;let crit;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);c.stage(c.t,-1,['atk']);}}};try{turn(s,38536,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(crit,true);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500+sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);turn(s,29455,20309);turn(s,29455,20309);assert.equal(s.round,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.throws(()=>turn(s,38536,20309),/有 PP/);});

success.name: 4946/2146转化已点亮雷辰真实清空原持有者并连接自身，按原答北西顺序不隔离真实策略
success.assertion: test('4946/2146转化已点亮雷辰真实清空原持有者并连接自身，按原答北西顺序不隔离真实策略',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4676-NEXT50/4765/snapshot.json'),ids=enemy.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth).slice(0,4).map(m=>m.id),fifth=enemy.moves.find(m=>m.fifth).id;const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,enemySoul:true,enemySource:enemy,enemyLoadout:[...ids,fifth]});const st=s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966;st.stars=[3,2];st.connections=[[3,2]];st.last=2;turn(s,29455,ids.find(id=>enemy.moves.find(m=>m.id===id).kind==='status'));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.connections,[[0,3]]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966.sourceHash,'ea01fd9');});

success.name: 4946/辰律实际逐点增加至4，共享槽位参与ㄣ形，末一次载荷后保留且不隔离规则
success.assertion: test('4946/辰律实际逐点增加至4，共享槽位参与ㄣ形，末一次载荷后保留且不隔离规则',()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true});assert.equal(grantBeforeUse(s,5,20117),4);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLawState2146.events.map(e=>e.added),[1,1,1,1,0]);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLawState2146.lastEnd.count,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146,4);});

success.name: 4946/辰律单点结束清回合清强麻痹保持原文顺序，回合保护/次数免异/反弹分别生效

success.name: 4946后续比例与前序50%合计限30%，镜子按实际减少量累计且试算不重复授予，真实穿减仍在总上限之后
success.assertion: test('4946后续比例与前序50%合计限30%，镜子按实际减少量累计且试算不重复授予，真实穿减仍在总上限之后',()=>{for(const pierce of [false,true]){const {s,action}=battle(3432,2150);timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.5});if(pierce)timer(s,0,'冰呪');turn(s,38536,action);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-(pierce?1520:700))<=1);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress>0&&s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress<500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrors??0,0);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,1);}});

success.name: 4946非红技能后续60%按总上限分配并保留逐层取整，统计与伤害事件不重复，非技能伤不触发此层
success.assertion: test('4946非红技能后续60%按总上限分配并保留逐层取整，统计与伤害事件不重复，非技能伤不触发此层',()=>{for(const mode of ['plain','combined','outside-skill']){const {s,action}=battle(3886,1971,{move:29455,index:-1,bStats:{maxHp:9000,def:300}});if(mode==='combined')timer(s,1,'全伤害减半');let saved;const wiki=E.WIKI,engine=wiki.effectsEngine,run=engine.run,old=E.SOULS;if(mode==='outside-skill')E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.hurt(c.t,1000,'非技能时点魂印伤害接口','percent');saved=c.t.soulState.coldSaved??0;}}};else E.WIKI={...wiki,effectsEngine:{...engine,run(phase,ops,c){const result=run.call(engine,phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0){c.hurt(c.t,1000,'真实技能非红结算接口','percent');saved=c.t.soulState.coldSaved;}return result;}}};try{turn(s,29455,action);}finally{E.WIKI=wiki;E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='outside-skill'?1000:mode==='combined'?699:700);assert.equal(saved,mode==='outside-skill'?0:mode==='combined'?113:300);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='percent').length,1);assert.equal(s.reductionPlans2146.filter(e=>e.kind==='other').length,1);}});

success.assertion: test('4946镜子动态百分比跨档需多轮计算时，最终只记一次真实减伤与授镜，PP、随机和伤害事件不重复',()=>{const {s,action}=battle(3432,2150,{aStats:{atk:4072},bStats:{maxHp:9000,def:300}});s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress=490;timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.5});const pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)];turn(s,38536,action);assert.equal(sum(s),720);assert.equal(s.reductionPlans2146.length,1);assert.equal(s.reductionPlans2146[0].iterations,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrors,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress,12);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,1);});

success.name: 4946总减伤不改已核实1946石化免攻反弹，固粉比例另按总30%并保留原状态
success.assertion: test('4946总减伤不改已核实1946石化免攻反弹，固粉比例另按总30%并保留原状态',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4676-NEXT50/4743/snapshot.json'),opts={move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[10006,38536,29455,29456,38538],enemySource:enemy,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[10127,20045,20111,10121,37856]},s=make(opts);timer(s,1,'纳多雷异常减伤',{count:0,stone:true});turn(s,38536,20045);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.ok(sum(s,'fixed',1)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['纳多雷异常减伤'].stone,true);const x=make({...opts,move:29455});timer(x,1,'纳多雷异常减伤',{count:5,stone:false});timer(x,1,'全伤害减半');const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,1000,'1946已核实双非红比例','percent');}};try{turn(x,29455,20045);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(x,'percent')-700)<=1);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].effects['纳多雷异常减伤'].count,5);});

success.assertion: test('4946新008已答满四真实星时不获得：真实2572击败仍授雷解，拒绝辰律且不安排未获得点的结束载荷',()=>{const s=make({move:38537,index:4,soul:true,targetHp:1});s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:[0,3,1,2],connections:[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]],last:2};timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:1});const pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38537)],old=E.SOULS;let leiJieBeforeAwake;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)leiJieBeforeAwake=!!c.a.ailments['雷解'];}};try{turn(s,38537,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const f=s.fighters[0],state=f.soulState.chenLawState2146;assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(f.pp[key(38537)],pp-1);assert.equal(leiJieBeforeAwake,true);assert.equal(f.ailments['雷解'],undefined);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,0);assert.equal(state.events.length,1);assert.equal(state.events[0].added,0);assert.equal(state.events[0].refusedFullSlots,true);assert.deepEqual(state.pending,[]);assert.equal(state.lastEnd,undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4946共享四槽真实星与辰律混合：有空槽才加点并连接，满槽不替换不待位，保留点可被末位消耗',()=>{for(const real of [0,2,3,4]){const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[29455,38537,10006,29456,38538]}),path=[0,3,1,2].slice(0,real);s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:path,connections:path.slice(1).map((n,i)=>[path[i],n]),last:path.at(-1)??null};const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2146].abilities.gainLaw(c);}};try{turn(s,29455,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const f=s.fighters[0],added=real<4?1:0;assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,added);assert.equal(f.soulState.lei1966.stars.length,real+added);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.lawSlots2146,added?[[0,3,1,2][real]]:[]);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLawState2146.events[0].refusedFullSlots,real===4);}});

success.assertion: test('4946已答辰律结束留点、下回不重复载荷，2571可消费真实末位辰律并更新点数连接与声明',()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[29455,38537,10006,29456,38538]});s.moveDefinitions[key(38537)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(38537)].operations.filter(op=>op.effectId===2571);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2146].abilities.gainLaw(c);},()=>turn(s,29455,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLawState2146.lastEnd.round,1);delete s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'];turn(s,38537,20117);const f=s.fighters[0];assert.equal(f.soulState.executionTarget2571.consumedStar,0);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,0);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.lawSlots2146,[]);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLawState2146.lastEnd.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,1);});

interaction.name: 4946/2146单来源攻击减伤严格最多30%，20%保持、50%及80%与30%结果一致，无减伤可正常攻击
interaction.assertion: test('4946/2146单来源攻击减伤严格最多30%，20%保持、50%及80%与30%结果一致，无减伤可正常攻击',()=>{const damage=[];for(const fraction of[0,.2,.3,.5,.8]){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true});if(fraction)timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction});turn(s,38536,20309);damage.push(sum(s));}assert.ok(damage[0]>damage[1]&&damage[1]>damage[2]);assert.equal(damage[2],damage[3]);assert.equal(damage[2],damage[4]);});

interaction.name: 4946/2146控制未能实际用攻不触发麻痹吸取且不耗PP，血药不冒充攻击用招
interaction.assertion: test('4946/2146控制未能实际用攻不触发麻痹吸取且不耗PP，血药不冒充攻击用招',()=>{const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500});s.fighters[0].ailments['睡眠']=3;const pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)];turn(s,38536,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)],pp);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain,undefined);turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4750);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain,undefined);});

interaction.name: 4946已答七成吸取及汲取均以敌最大HP为基数按理论量魂印回复，残血和免伤不降低，技能禁疗与一般倍率独立
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答七成吸取及汲取均以敌最大HP为基数按理论量魂印回复，残血和免伤不降低，技能禁疗与一般倍率独立',()=>{for(const mode of ['normal','percent-immune','all-immune','skill-ban','half-heal','zero-heal']){const s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,bStats:{maxHp:3000},targetHp:1000});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='percent-immune'||mode==='all-immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='all-immune')timer(s,1,'当回合免伤');if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='half-heal'||mode==='zero-heal')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:mode==='half-heal'?.5:1});turn(s,38536,20309);const f=s.fighters[0],result=f.soulState.thunder2146.lastDrain;assert.equal(result.requested,2100);assert.equal(result.basis,'maxHp');assert.equal(result.type,['percent-immune','all-immune'].includes(mode)?'true':'percent');assert.equal(f.hp,mode==='zero-heal'?4500:mode==='half-heal'?5550:6600);if(mode==='all-immune'){assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),0);assert.equal(result.settledDamage,0);}else{assert.equal(result.settledDamage,2100);assert.ok(result.hpLoss<2100);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}}});

interaction.name: 4946已答真实2132动态减伤与多静态来源合计30%，先限后穿减且不改原减伤记录
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答真实2132动态减伤与多静态来源合计30%，先限后穿减且不改原减伤记录',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4937/snapshot.json');for(const pierce of [false,true]){const a=make({...opts,enemySource:enemy,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[10127,20045,20111,10051,38506]}),b=make({...opts,soul:false,enemySource:enemy,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[10127,20045,20111,10051,38506]});a.fighters[1].soulState.renado2132.reductionRound=1;a.fighters[1].soulState.renado2132.reduction=.5;timer(a,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.4});timer(a,1,'战狂下回合减伤');if(pierce)for(const x of[a,b])timer(x,0,'冰呪');turn(a,38536,20045);turn(b,38536,20045);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a)-sum(b)*(pierce?.76:.7))<=2,JSON.stringify({pierce,actual:sum(a),base:sum(b)}));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].soulState.renado2132.reduction,.5);}});

interaction.name: 4946已答晨曦及养成暴击抗性纳入总减伤并先限后穿，原抗性值与套装不改写
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答晨曦及养成暴击抗性纳入总减伤并先限后穿，原抗性值与套装不改写',()=>{for(const [dawn,resistance,pierce]of [[true,0,false],[true,80,false],[false,100,false],[true,80,true]]){const a=make(opts),b=make({...opts,soul:false});timer(a,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.5});a.fighters[1].build.resistance.critical=resistance;if(dawn)a.fighters[1].build.suit='dawn';for(const x of[a,b]){timer(x,0,'必定暴击');if(pierce)timer(x,0,'冰呪');}turn(a,38536,20117);turn(b,38536,20117);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a)-sum(b)*(pierce?.76:.7))<=2,JSON.stringify({dawn,resistance,pierce,actual:sum(a),base:sum(b)}));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].build.resistance.critical,resistance);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].build.suit,dawn?'dawn':'none');}});

interaction.name: 4946已答后续生命结算层比例同受总30%上限，实际旧新柯尔霍德与旧新柯尔德保留魂印版本且只消费一次PP
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答后续生命结算层比例同受总30%上限，实际旧新柯尔霍德与旧新柯尔德保留魂印版本且只消费一次PP',()=>{for(const [pet,soul]of [[3432,748],[3432,2150],[3886,1155],[3886,1971]]){const {s,action}=battle(pet,soul),pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)];turn(s,38536,action);assert.equal(sum(s),700,soul);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,1);assert.equal(s.reductionPlans2146.length,1);assert.ok(s.reductionPlans2146[0].iterations>=2&&s.reductionPlans2146[0].iterations<=64);if(soul===2150){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress,300);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrors??0,0);}}});

interaction.name: 4946后续比例保留阈值成败与原定额200上限，已免伤归零不授镜，前盾后减伤次序不移动
interaction.assertion: test('4946后续比例保留阈值成败与原定额200上限，已免伤归零不授镜，前盾后减伤次序不移动',()=>{for(const mode of ['below','threshold','shield','cap200','immune']){const soul=mode==='cap200'?1155:mode==='immune'?2150:748,{s,action}=battle(soul===1155?3886:3432,soul,{bStats:{maxHp:2000,def:300},targetHp:mode==='below'?2000:mode==='threshold'?2000:1000});if(mode==='shield')s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=200;if(mode==='cap200')s.fighters[1].soulState.coldNextCap=true;if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,38536,action);if(mode==='below'||mode==='threshold')assert.equal(sum(s),1000);if(mode==='shield')assert.equal(sum(s),560);if(mode==='cap200'){assert.equal(sum(s),200);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.coldNextCap,undefined);}if(mode==='immune'){assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress??0,0);}}});

interaction.name: 4946后续比例与前序50%合计限30%，镜子按实际减少量累计且试算不重复授予，真实穿减仍在总上限之后
interaction.assertion: test('4946后续比例与前序50%合计限30%，镜子按实际减少量累计且试算不重复授予，真实穿减仍在总上限之后',()=>{for(const pierce of [false,true]){const {s,action}=battle(3432,2150);timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.5});if(pierce)timer(s,0,'冰呪');turn(s,38536,action);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-(pierce?1520:700))<=1);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress>0&&s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress<500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrors??0,0);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4946非红技能后续60%按总上限分配并保留逐层取整，统计与伤害事件不重复，非技能伤不触发此层
interaction.assertion: test('4946非红技能后续60%按总上限分配并保留逐层取整，统计与伤害事件不重复，非技能伤不触发此层',()=>{for(const mode of ['plain','combined','outside-skill']){const {s,action}=battle(3886,1971,{move:29455,index:-1,bStats:{maxHp:9000,def:300}});if(mode==='combined')timer(s,1,'全伤害减半');let saved;const wiki=E.WIKI,engine=wiki.effectsEngine,run=engine.run,old=E.SOULS;if(mode==='outside-skill')E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0){c.hurt(c.t,1000,'非技能时点魂印伤害接口','percent');saved=c.t.soulState.coldSaved??0;}}};else E.WIKI={...wiki,effectsEngine:{...engine,run(phase,ops,c){const result=run.call(engine,phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0){c.hurt(c.t,1000,'真实技能非红结算接口','percent');saved=c.t.soulState.coldSaved;}return result;}}};try{turn(s,29455,action);}finally{E.WIKI=wiki;E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='outside-skill'?1000:mode==='combined'?699:700);assert.equal(saved,mode==='outside-skill'?0:mode==='combined'?113:300);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='percent').length,1);assert.equal(s.reductionPlans2146.filter(e=>e.kind==='other').length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4946镜子动态百分比跨档需多轮计算时，最终只记一次真实减伤与授镜，PP、随机和伤害事件不重复
interaction.assertion: test('4946镜子动态百分比跨档需多轮计算时，最终只记一次真实减伤与授镜，PP、随机和伤害事件不重复',()=>{const {s,action}=battle(3432,2150,{aStats:{atk:4072},bStats:{maxHp:9000,def:300}});s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress=490;timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.5});const pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)];turn(s,38536,action);assert.equal(sum(s),720);assert.equal(s.reductionPlans2146.length,1);assert.equal(s.reductionPlans2146[0].iterations,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrors,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.mirrorProgress,12);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38536)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack').length,1);});

interaction.name: 4946总减伤不阻塞已核实伽玛超频保1HP层，1HP正结算照常记录不伪装成减伤
interaction.assertion: test('4946总减伤不阻塞已核实伽玛超频保1HP层，1HP正结算照常记录不伪装成减伤',()=>{const enemy=require('../local-species.cjs').species(3896),ids=enemy.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth).slice(0,4).map(m=>m.id),s=make({move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[10006,38536,29455,29456,38538],enemySource:enemy,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[...ids,enemy.moves.find(m=>m.fifth).id],targetHp:1});assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulId,1959);s.fighters[1].ailments['超频']=3;turn(s,38536,20030);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.ok(e.settledDamage>0);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['超频'],3);});

interaction.name: 4946总减伤不改已核实1946石化免攻反弹，固粉比例另按总30%并保留原状态
interaction.assertion: test('4946总减伤不改已核实1946石化免攻反弹，固粉比例另按总30%并保留原状态',()=>{const enemy=require('../research/BATCH-4676-NEXT50/4743/snapshot.json'),opts={move:38536,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[10006,38536,29455,29456,38538],enemySource:enemy,enemySoul:true,enemyLoadout:[10127,20045,20111,10121,37856]},s=make(opts);timer(s,1,'纳多雷异常减伤',{count:0,stone:true});turn(s,38536,20045);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.ok(sum(s,'fixed',1)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['纳多雷异常减伤'].stone,true);const x=make({...opts,move:29455});timer(x,1,'纳多雷异常减伤',{count:5,stone:false});timer(x,1,'全伤害减半');const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,1000,'1946已核实双非红比例','percent');}};try{turn(x,29455,20045);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(x,'percent')-700)<=1);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].effects['纳多雷异常减伤'].count,5);});

interaction.name: 4946新007已答225：实际原攻击1000、修罗原层600后续减200，总上限300按贡献分配，实际受700并获得225意念
interaction.assertion: test('4946新007已答225：实际原攻击1000、修罗原层600后续减200，总上限300按贡献分配，实际受700并获得225意念',()=>{const s=shura(),st=s.fighters[1].soulState.shura2128,e=st.damageChanges.find(e=>e.kind==='reduction');assert.equal(e.unit,1000);assert.equal(e.coefficient,.225);assert.equal(e.amount,225);assert.equal(st.thought,225);assert.equal(sum(s),700);assert.equal(s.moveDefinitions[key(38536)].type,'圣灵电');assert.equal(s.round,2);});

interaction.name: 4946新007比例分配保留原层先后权重、穿减与免伤盾后统计规则，不按统一穿减系数误算各层贡献
interaction.assertion: test('4946新007比例分配保留原层先后权重、穿减与免伤盾后统计规则，不按统一穿减系数误算各层贡献',()=>{for(const mode of ['prior','immune','shield','pierce']){const s=shura(mode),st=s.fighters[1].soulState.shura2128,e=st.damageChanges.find(e=>e.kind==='reduction'),coefficient=mode==='pierce'?.18:.225;assert.ok(Math.abs(e.coefficient-coefficient)<1e-12,mode);assert.equal(st.thought,Math.floor(e.unit*coefficient+1e-9));if(['immune','shield'].includes(mode))assert.equal(sum(s),0);if(mode==='prior')assert.equal(sum(s),700);if(mode==='pierce'){assert.equal(e.unit,2000);assert.equal(st.thought,360);assert.equal(sum(s),1520);}}});

interaction.name: 4946新008已答满四真实星时不获得：真实2572击败仍授雷解，拒绝辰律且不安排未获得点的结束载荷
interaction.assertion: test('4946新008已答满四真实星时不获得：真实2572击败仍授雷解，拒绝辰律且不安排未获得点的结束载荷',()=>{const s=make({move:38537,index:4,soul:true,targetHp:1});s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:[0,3,1,2],connections:[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]],last:2};timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:1});const pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38537)],old=E.SOULS;let leiJieBeforeAwake;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)leiJieBeforeAwake=!!c.a.ailments['雷解'];}};try{turn(s,38537,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const f=s.fighters[0],state=f.soulState.chenLawState2146;assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(f.pp[key(38537)],pp-1);assert.equal(leiJieBeforeAwake,true);assert.equal(f.ailments['雷解'],undefined);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,0);assert.equal(state.events.length,1);assert.equal(state.events[0].added,0);assert.equal(state.events[0].refusedFullSlots,true);assert.deepEqual(state.pending,[]);assert.equal(state.lastEnd,undefined);});

interaction.name: 4946共享四槽真实星与辰律混合：有空槽才加点并连接，满槽不替换不待位，保留点可被末位消耗
interaction.assertion: test('4946共享四槽真实星与辰律混合：有空槽才加点并连接，满槽不替换不待位，保留点可被末位消耗',()=>{for(const real of [0,2,3,4]){const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[29455,38537,10006,29456,38538]}),path=[0,3,1,2].slice(0,real);s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:path,connections:path.slice(1).map((n,i)=>[path[i],n]),last:path.at(-1)??null};const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2146].abilities.gainLaw(c);}};try{turn(s,29455,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const f=s.fighters[0],added=real<4?1:0;assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,added);assert.equal(f.soulState.lei1966.stars.length,real+added);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.lawSlots2146,added?[[0,3,1,2][real]]:[]);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLawState2146.events[0].refusedFullSlots,real===4);}});

interaction.name: 4946已答纯辰律逐点占槽按北西东南并参与ㄣ形，最多4点同回末只清强清回合麻痹一次且保留
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答纯辰律逐点占槽按北西东南并参与ㄣ形，最多4点同回末只清强清回合麻痹一次且保留',()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)for(let i=0;i<5;i++)E.SOULS.registry[2146].abilities.gainLaw(c);},()=>turn(s,29455,20117));const f=s.fighters[0],st=f.soulState.chenLawState2146;assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,4);assert.deepEqual(st.events.map(e=>e.added),[1,1,1,1,0]);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.lawSlots2146,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.connections,[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]]);assert.equal(f.soulState.lei1966.awake.start,2);assert.equal(st.lastEnd.count,1);assert.equal(st.retainedAfterEnd.count,4);assert.equal(st.pending.length,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);});

interaction.name: 4946已答辰律结束留点、下回不重复载荷，2571可消费真实末位辰律并更新点数连接与声明
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答辰律结束留点、下回不重复载荷，2571可消费真实末位辰律并更新点数连接与声明',()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[29455,38537,10006,29456,38538]});s.moveDefinitions[key(38537)].operations=s.moveDefinitions[key(38537)].operations.filter(op=>op.effectId===2571);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)E.SOULS.registry[2146].abilities.gainLaw(c);},()=>turn(s,29455,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLawState2146.lastEnd.round,1);delete s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'];turn(s,38537,20117);const f=s.fighters[0];assert.equal(f.soulState.executionTarget2571.consumedStar,0);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,0);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.lawSlots2146,[]);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLawState2146.lastEnd.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,1);});

interaction.name: 4946真实38537击败后2572授雷解与辰律，保留真实来源参数，不隔离映射或留存

interaction.name: 4946真实星与辰律共享槽：保留自身辰律，当前对手的视为雷辰可转化，危急补满四槽不覆盖已有点数
interaction.assertion: test('4946真实星与辰律共享槽：保留自身辰律，当前对手的视为雷辰可转化，危急补满四槽不覆盖已有点数',()=>{/* The current opponent starts with shared-law state; acquisition by an off-field ally remains deferred. */const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,2146);s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146=1;s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:[0,3],connections:[[0,3]],last:3,lawSlots2146:[3]};s.fighters[1].soulState.chenLaw2146=2;s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:[0,3],connections:[[0,3]],last:3,lawSlots2146:[0,3]};turn(s,29455,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146,1);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.lawSlots2146,[2]);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.chenLaw2146,0);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.transferredResources[0].lawConvertedToReal,2);const p=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});p.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146=2;p.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:[0,3],connections:[[0,3]],last:3,lawSlots2146:[0,3]};turn(p,29455,20117);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146,2);assert.deepEqual(p.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(p.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.lawSlots2146,[1,2]);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.awake.start,2);});

interaction.name: 4946已答获得四颗雷辰按北西东南连接，危急真实回血净回合清普通盾而留罩，一场只一次并次回觉醒
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答获得四颗雷辰按北西东南连接，危急真实回血净回合清普通盾而留罩，一场只一次并次回觉醒',()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=300;s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier=400;turn(s,29455,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,400);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.connections,[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.awake,{start:2,end:4,sourceHash:'aab36e4c'});s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s,29455,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.starEvents.filter(e=>e.kind==='gain-four').length,1);});

interaction.name: 4946已答场上纯雷辰转化汇总并按北西东南前x槽重排，真实移除对方星和待觉醒，保持其已生效觉醒
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答场上纯雷辰转化汇总并按北西东南前x槽重排，真实移除对方星和待觉醒，保持其已生效觉醒',()=>{for(const [own,other]of [[[],[2]],[[2],[1,0]],[[1,2,3],[3,2,1]],[[],[3,2,0,1]]]){const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true}),count=Math.min(4,own.length+other.length);s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={stars:own.slice(),connections:[],last:own.at(-1)??null};s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966={stars:other.slice(),connections:[],last:other.at(-1),pending:{round:1,kind:'awake'},awake:{start:1,end:3,sourceHash:'ea01fd9'}};turn(s,29455,20117);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2].slice(0,count));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.last,[0,3,1,2][count-1]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966.stars,[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966.pending,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966.awake.end,3);if(count===4)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.awake.start,2);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4946已答静态多来源叠加后的总减伤最多30%，先限再穿减，低于30%原比例保留',()=>{for(const [x,y,ignore]of [[.1,.1,0],[.1,.1,.2],[.2,.2,0],[.5,.5,0],[.5,.5,.2],[.8,.5,.2]]){const s=make(options),b=make({...options,soul:false});timer(s,1,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:x});timer(s,1,'全伤害减半',{});if(y!==.5){delete s.fighters[1].effects['全伤害减半'];timer(s,1,'幻境本回合减攻',{fraction:y});}if(ignore)for(const x of[s,b])timer(x,0,'冰呪');turn(s,38536,20117);turn(b,38536,20117);const factor=1-Math.min(.3,1-(1-x)*(1-y))*(1-ignore);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*factor)<=2,JSON.stringify({x,y,ignore,actual:sum(s),base:sum(b),factor}));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-sum(s));}});

interaction.name: 4946已答非红静态比例与已核实养成抗性套装减伤合计最多30%，免伤独立且无魂印原规则不改
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答非红静态比例与已核实养成抗性套装减伤合计最多30%，免伤独立且无魂印原规则不改',()=>{for(const type of ['fixed','percent','true']){const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true}),b=make({move:29455,index:-1});for(const x of[s,b]){timer(x,1,'全伤害减半');timer(x,1,'固定百分比减伤',{fraction:.5});x.fighters[1].build.resistance.fixed=50;x.fighters[1].build.resistance.percent=50;x.fighters[1].build.suit='destiny';x.fighters[1].suitState.stacks=10;}const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,1000,'已核实非红总减伤接口',type);}};try{turn(s,29455,20117);turn(b,29455,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s,type)-700)<=2,type);assert.equal(sum(b,type),type==='true'?500:100);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-sum(s,type));}});

success.name: 4946全部21招基础行为独立于另有专项验证的效果指令：真实PP扣1、0PP拒绝且回合与HP不变
success.assertion: test('4946全部21招基础行为独立于另有专项验证的效果指令：真实PP扣1、0PP拒绝且回合与HP不变',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];assert.equal(before,m.pp);turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));const p=make({move:m.id,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;const hp=p.fighters.map(f=>f.hp);assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);assert.deepEqual(p.fighters.map(f=>f.hp),hp);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],0);}});

success.name: 4946/2591已答下回合增伤，未击败实际各槽PP恢复1且不超上限；2572不隔离辰律，击败实际附雷解与留点
success.assertion: test('4946/2591已答下回合增伤，未击败实际各槽PP恢复1且不超上限；2572不隔离辰律，击败实际附雷解与留点',()=>{const s=make(row(2591));for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],Math.min(s.moveDefinitions[k].pp,k===key(s.auditMoveId)?1:2));const p=make({...row(2572),targetHp:1}),old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,1,'已准备命中附伤','fixed');}};try{turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(p.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.ok(p.fighters[0].ailments['雷解']);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146,1);});

success.name: 4946/1700同源重复解除弱化只刷新免异1次，无法解除时不授予
success.assertion: test('4946/1700同源重复解除弱化只刷新免异1次，无法解除时不授予',()=>{const s=make({move:38537,index:1});for(let n=0;n<2;n++){s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-1;turn(s,38537,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);}const p=make({move:38537,index:1});p.fighters[0].stages.atk=-1;timer(p,0,'弱化不可解除反转');turn(p,38537,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,0);});

success.name: 4946/1700异源已有2次保留，后授自身1次先消费，不误消费异源
success.assertion: test('4946/1700异源已有2次保留，后授自身1次先消费，不误消费异源',()=>{const s=make({move:38537,index:1}),old=E.SOULS;s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-1;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.grantOracleImmunity(c.a,2,'test-existing-other-source','1700');if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);}};try{turn(s,38537,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.ailmentImmuneSources.some(e=>e.key==='test-existing-other-source'&&e.count===2));});

success.name: 4946/10两实例真实麻痹概率与免疫，1按实际红伤一半回复，749全弱
success.assertion: test('4946/10两实例真实麻痹概率与免疫，1按实际红伤一半回复，749全弱',()=>{for(const r of rows(10)){const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=40;seed++){const s=make({...r,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set(r.args[0]===100?[true]:[true,false]));const s=make(r);s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);}for(const ban of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(1),hp:1000});if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(ban?0:Math.floor(sum(s)/2)));}const q=make(row(749));turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(q.fighters[1].stages[k],-1);});

success.name: 4946全部21招64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生2146完整效果链含未击败第五与零威力攻击，不绕开词条
success.assertion: test('4946全部21招64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生2146完整效果链含未击败第五与零威力攻击，不绕开词条',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.sourceHash,'aab36e4c');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.fifth?before:before-1,m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));if(m.kind!=='status'&&m.power>0)assert.ok(sum(s)>0,m.name);if(m.fifth){assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913.start,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913.end,2);}const p=make({move:m.id,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.assertion: test('4946/57既授真实用招整招无效仍回血，技能禁疗阻止、药剂不触发；821后手延长保护回合',()=>{const s=make({...row(57),hp:1000});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);s.fighters[0].hp=1000;timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);const q=make({...row(57),hp:1000});timer(q,0,'技能禁疗');turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].hp,1000);turn(q,null,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].hp,1250);for(const r of rows(821)){const ends=[];for(const slow of[false,true]){const p=make({...r,aStats:{spe:slow?1:500}});turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].effects.protect.end,slow?3:2);const old=E.SOULS;let cleared;E.SOULS={...old,run(ev,c){old.run(ev,c);if(ev==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)cleared=c.clear(c.t);}};try{turn(p,null,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(!!cleared,false);assert.equal(!!p.fighters[0].effects.protect,slow);ends.push(p.fighters[0].effects);}assert.notDeepEqual(ends[0],ends[1]);}});

success.assertion: test('4946/1209清双方正负按实际总段附伤、47免弱；429连续150/250/350封顶并中断重置',()=>{const s=make(row(1209));s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;s.fighters[0].stages.spa=-3;s.fighters[1].stages.def=1;s.fighters[1].stages.acc=-2;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),400);for(const f of s.fighters)for(const k of keys)assert.equal(f.stages[k],0);const p=make(row(47)),old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.stage(c.t,-1);}};try{turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}for(const k of keys)assert.equal(p.fighters[0].stages[k],0);const q=make(row(429));for(const expected of[150,250,350]){turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(q,'fixed'),expected);}turn(q,null,20309);turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(q,'fixed'),350);q.moveDefinitions[key(38536)].operations=[];turn(q,38536,20309);turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(q,'fixed'),150);});

success.name: 4946全部21招64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生2146完整效果链含未击败第五与零威力攻击，不绕开词条
success.assertion: test('4946全部21招64种子基础命中暴击先制PP，原生2146完整效果链含未击败第五与零威力攻击，不绕开词条',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.sourceHash,'aab36e4c');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.fifth?before:before-1,m.name);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));if(m.kind!=='status'&&m.power>0)assert.ok(sum(s)>0,m.name);if(m.fifth){assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913.start,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913.end,2);}const p=make({move:m.id,soul:true});p.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);assert.equal(p.round,1);}});

success.assertion: test('4946/57既授真实用招整招无效仍回血，技能禁疗阻止、药剂不触发；821后手延长保护回合',()=>{const s=make({...row(57),hp:1000});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);s.fighters[0].hp=1000;timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);const q=make({...row(57),hp:1000});timer(q,0,'技能禁疗');turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].hp,1000);turn(q,null,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].hp,1250);for(const r of rows(821)){const ends=[];for(const slow of[false,true]){const p=make({...r,aStats:{spe:slow?1:500}});turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].effects.protect.end,slow?3:2);const old=E.SOULS;let cleared;E.SOULS={...old,run(ev,c){old.run(ev,c);if(ev==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)cleared=c.clear(c.t);}};try{turn(p,null,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(!!cleared,false);assert.equal(!!p.fighters[0].effects.protect,slow);ends.push(p.fighters[0].effects);}assert.notDeepEqual(ends[0],ends[1]);}});

success.assertion: test('4946/2591已答下回合增伤，未击败实际各槽PP恢复1且不超上限；2572不隔离辰律，击败实际附雷解与留点',()=>{const s=make(row(2591));for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],Math.min(s.moveDefinitions[k].pp,k===key(s.auditMoveId)?1:2));const p=make({...row(2572),targetHp:1}),old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,1,'已准备命中附伤','fixed');}};try{turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(p.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.ok(p.fighters[0].ailments['雷解']);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.chenLaw2146,1);});

success.assertion: test('4946新008已答满四真实星时不获得：真实2572击败仍授雷解，拒绝辰律且不安排未获得点的结束载荷',()=>{const s=make({move:38537,index:4,soul:true,targetHp:1});s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={sourceHash:'aab36e4c',stars:[0,3,1,2],connections:[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]],last:2};timer(s,0,'攻击最低伤害',{amount:1});const pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38537)],old=E.SOULS;let leiJieBeforeAwake;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)leiJieBeforeAwake=!!c.a.ailments['雷解'];}};try{turn(s,38537,20117);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}const f=s.fighters[0],state=f.soulState.chenLawState2146;assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(f.pp[key(38537)],pp-1);assert.equal(leiJieBeforeAwake,true);assert.equal(f.ailments['雷解'],undefined);assert.deepEqual(f.soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.equal(f.soulState.chenLaw2146,0);assert.equal(state.events.length,1);assert.equal(state.events[0].added,0);assert.equal(state.events[0].refusedFullSlots,true);assert.deepEqual(state.pending,[]);assert.equal(state.lastEnd,undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4946/2591最新原答下回合增伤：未KO实际回PP，当前真实额外电击不翻倍，次回翻倍后到期',()=>{const s=make({move:38538,index:4,loadout:[10006,...source.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth&&m.id!==10006).slice(-3).map(m=>m.id),38538]}),wiki=E.WIKI,engine=wiki.effectsEngine,old=engine.run;let out;const wrappedRun=function(phase,ops,c){const result=old.call(this,phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0&&(c.m.wikiId??c.m.id)===38538&&ops.some(op=>op.effectId===2591)){out={timer:{...c.a.effects.id913},pp:c.a.pp[key(38538)]};const component=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)];c.a.effects['必定暴击']={start:c.round,end:c.round};let before=c.t.hp;c.reproduceSkillComponent(component);out.boosted=before-c.t.hp;delete c.a.effects.id913;before=c.t.hp;c.reproduceSkillComponent(component);out.plain=before-c.t.hp;c.a.effects.id913=out.timer;}return result;};E.WIKI={...wiki,effectsEngine:{...engine,run:wrappedRun}};try{turn(s,38538,20117);}finally{E.WIKI=wiki;}assert.equal(out.timer.start,2);assert.equal(out.timer.end,2);assert.equal(out.timer.bonus,1);assert.equal(out.pp,5);assert.ok(out.plain>0);assert.ok(out.boosted/out.plain>.8&&out.boosted/out.plain<1.2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913.start,2);const ref=structuredClone(s);delete ref.fighters[0].effects.id913;turn(s,10006,20117);turn(ref,10006,20117);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-2*sum(ref))<=2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913,undefined);turn(s,10006,20117);turn(ref,10006,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(ref));});

interaction.name: 4946/2591最新原答下回合增伤：未KO实际回PP，当前真实额外电击不翻倍，次回翻倍后到期
interaction.assertion: test('4946/2591最新原答下回合增伤：未KO实际回PP，当前真实额外电击不翻倍，次回翻倍后到期',()=>{const s=make({move:38538,index:4,loadout:[10006,...source.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth&&m.id!==10006).slice(-3).map(m=>m.id),38538]}),wiki=E.WIKI,engine=wiki.effectsEngine,old=engine.run;let out;const wrappedRun=function(phase,ops,c){const result=old.call(this,phase,ops,c);if(phase==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0&&(c.m.wikiId??c.m.id)===38538&&ops.some(op=>op.effectId===2591)){out={timer:{...c.a.effects.id913},pp:c.a.pp[key(38538)]};const component=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)];c.a.effects['必定暴击']={start:c.round,end:c.round};let before=c.t.hp;c.reproduceSkillComponent(component);out.boosted=before-c.t.hp;delete c.a.effects.id913;before=c.t.hp;c.reproduceSkillComponent(component);out.plain=before-c.t.hp;c.a.effects.id913=out.timer;}return result;};E.WIKI={...wiki,effectsEngine:{...engine,run:wrappedRun}};try{turn(s,38538,20117);}finally{E.WIKI=wiki;}assert.equal(out.timer.start,2);assert.equal(out.timer.end,2);assert.equal(out.timer.bonus,1);assert.equal(out.pp,5);assert.ok(out.plain>0);assert.ok(out.boosted/out.plain>.8&&out.boosted/out.plain<1.2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913.start,2);const ref=structuredClone(s);delete ref.fighters[0].effects.id913;turn(s,10006,20117);turn(ref,10006,20117);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-2*sum(ref))<=2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects.id913,undefined);turn(s,10006,20117);turn(ref,10006,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(ref));});

interaction.assertion: test('4946已答获得四颗雷辰按北西东南连接，危急真实回血净回合清普通盾而留罩，一场只一次并次回觉醒',()=>{const s=make({move:29455,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=300;s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier=400;turn(s,29455,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.shield,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].suitState.barrier,400);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0,3,1,2]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.connections,[[0,3],[3,1],[1,2]]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.awake,{start:2,end:4,sourceHash:'aab36e4c'});s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s,29455,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.thunder2146.starEvents.filter(e=>e.kind==='gain-four').length,1);});

interaction.name: 4946已答重排后的真实末位雷辰由2571消耗，不以精灵编号或旧形状猜末位
interaction.assertion: test('4946已答重排后的真实末位雷辰由2571消耗，不以精灵编号或旧形状猜末位',()=>{const s=make({move:38537,index:3,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966={stars:[2],connections:[],last:2};s.fighters[1].soulState.lei1966={stars:[1],connections:[],last:1};turn(s,38537,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.executionTarget2571.consumedStar,3);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.stars,[0]);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.connections,[]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lei1966.last,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);});

instance.description: 击败对手则对方下只出战精灵首回合先制效果失效

raw.description: 攻击时造成的伤害不会出现微弱（克制关系为微弱时都变成普通）；自身拥有点亮的雷辰时威力提高160点；吸取对手最大体力的1/3，若对手免疫百分比伤害则100%令对手瘫痪；3回合内，双方的在场精灵无法成为场下精灵的效果目标；未击败对手则恢复自身所有技能1点PP值且1回合内造成的攻击伤害提升100%；击败对手则对方下只出战精灵首回合先制效果失效

success.name: 4946/760真实地面微弱修正为普通，42复用已确认下轮起始；2017真实击败分支不伪造下一只
success.assertion: test('4946/760真实地面微弱修正为普通，42复用已确认下轮起始；2017真实击败分支不伪造下一只',()=>{const a=make(row(760)),b=make({...row(760),index:-1});for(const s of[a,b])s.fighters[1].type='地面';const ratio=E.typeEffectiveness(a.moveDefinitions[key(a.auditMoveId)].type,'地面',a.typeChart);assert.ok(ratio>0&&ratio<1);turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(a)*ratio-sum(b))<=2);const p=make(row(42));turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].effects['电系伤害翻倍'].start,2);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].effects['电系伤害翻倍'].end,2);const q=make({...row(2017),targetHp:1});turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].hp,9000);});
